title: Public Sidewalk, Curb and Street Restoration Authorization under Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Public Sidewalk, Curb and Street Restoration Authorization

Authorization desk reference for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## What the payment is

The public-way restoration payment is the allowance Bridgewell authorizes on a covered exterior water service line, sewer lateral or gas service line service request toward cutting and restoring a public sidewalk, curb or street that the permanent work opens, booked as one allowance authorization of type public way restoration; a whole-line replacement always opens the public way, because it starts at the connection point.

For a public way restoration allowance, the amount paid is the public-way restoration payment, and only for such an allowance; every other authorization remains under the base rule that it pays the lower of its invoice amount and the remaining occurrence benefit. For a public sidewalk, curb or street, the public-way restoration payment is paid in place of the bare public way restoration allowance, still inside the occurrence cap, and only for such restoration; every other restoration allowance remains under the base rule.

## Effect on the claim record

Once booked, the payment appears in the plan's claim history as an allowance authorization of type public way restoration on that service request, under a new authorization number. Its amount is recorded both as the cost of the item and as the amount Bridgewell pays, and it counts toward the occurrence's benefit from that moment.

## Invoking the tool

The tool is `authorize_public_way_restoration_c5bbe6ee`. It is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it and then calls it.

### Parameters

- `customer_id` — the customer reference number of the plan holder, as returned by the customer profile lookup.
- `lineplan_contract_id` — the line protection plan number the service request belongs to, as returned by the plan lookup.
- `lineplan_service_request_id` — the line service request number the payment is booked on, as returned by the service request lookup.
- `line_type` — the line named on that service request, copied from the request record. One of:
  - `water_service_line` — the exterior water service line from the utility connection to the home
  - `sewer_lateral` — the exterior sewer lateral from the home to the public sewer connection
  - `septic_line` — the exterior line from the home to the septic tank
  - `electrical_service_line` — the exterior electrical service line and meter base
  - `interior_supply_line` — water supply piping inside the home or beneath its slab
  - `interior_drain_line` — drain and waste piping inside the home or beneath its slab
  - `gas_service_line` — the exterior gas service line
  - `well_line` — the line from a private well to the home
- `payment_amount` — the public-way restoration payment Bridgewell authorizes, in US dollars, a non-negative number rounded to 2 decimal places; the same figure is recorded as the item's cost and as the amount paid.

| Parameter | Kind | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | identifier | as returned by the customer profile lookup |
| `lineplan_contract_id` | identifier | as returned by the plan lookup |
| `lineplan_service_request_id` | identifier | as returned by the service request lookup |
| `line_type` | one of the eight line values | copied from the request record |
| `payment_amount` | amount in US dollars | non-negative, 2 decimal places |

### Return

A confirmation sentence stating the new authorization number (an identifier beginning with 5), the service request it was booked on, the allowance type `public_way_restoration` and the amount in US dollars with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the authorization is on file.
